mapper.select:
SELECT CP.*, CV.ConstrValDesc AS SaveReason, CI.CustName AS CustName, P.PointName AS PointName FROM shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail CP INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cSaveReasonCode') CV ON CP.SaveReasonCode = CV.ConstrVal INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CP.CustId = CI.CustId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrPoint P ON CP.PointId = P.PointId WHERE CP.State = 1 AND ( NOW() BETWEEN CP.ValidStartDate AND date_add(CP.ValidEndDate,interval+1 day) ) AND CI.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND CI.CustName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCustName},'%') AND CI.LoginId LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pLoginId},'%') AND CI.CustId = #{pCustId}
ORDER BY CP.${sidx} ${sord} ORDER BY CP.PointNo DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail CP INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cSaveReasonCode') CV ON CP.SaveReasonCode = CV.ConstrVal INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CP.CustId = CI.CustId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrPoint P ON CP.PointId = P.PointId WHERE CP.State = 1 AND ( NOW() BETWEEN CP.ValidStartDate AND date_add(CP.ValidEndDate,interval+1 day) ) AND CI.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND CI.CustName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCustName},'%') AND CI.LoginId LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pLoginId},'%') AND CI.CustId = #{pCustId}

SELECT CP.*, CV.ConstrValDesc AS SaveReason, CI.CustName AS CustName, P.PointName AS PointName FROM shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail CP INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cSaveReasonCode') CV ON CP.SaveReasonCode = CV.ConstrVal INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CP.CustId = CI.CustId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrPoint P ON CP.PointId = P.PointId WHERE CP.CustId = #{custId} AND CP.PointNo = #{pointNo}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CP.PointAmt),0) AS PointAmt FROM shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail CP INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cSaveReasonCode') CV ON CP.SaveReasonCode = CV.ConstrVal INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CP.CustId = CI.CustId LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tStrPoint P ON CP.PointId = P.PointId WHERE CP.CustId = #{pCustId} AND CP.State = 1 AND ( CURDATE() BETWEEN CP.ValidStartDate AND CP.ValidEndDate )
AND ( CP.ValidEndDate <= (INTERVAL 30 DAY + CURDATE()) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail ( CustId, PointAmt, SaveReasonCode, OrderNo, OrderProdNo, ValidStartDate, ValidEndDate, AcquisDate, PointId, ChnlCode, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName ) SELECT O.CustId, OP.PointSaveAmt, 'save' AS SaveReasonCode, O.OrderNo, OP.OrderProdNo, now() AS ValidStartDate, DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL 1 year) AS ValidEndDate, now() AS AcquisDate, 0 AS PointId, O.ChnlCode, 1 AS State, '' AS Remark, now() AS RegistDate, 'system' AS RegistId, 'system' AS RegistName FROM shopion.tOrdOrder O INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON O.OrderNo = OP.OrderNo WHERE OP.PointSaveAmt > 0 AND O.ShipCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND O.CustId > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail PD WHERE O.OrderNo = PD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = PD.OrderProdNo AND PointAmt > 0)

INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail ( CustId, PointAmt, SaveReasonCode, OrderNo, OrderProdNo, ValidStartDate, ValidEndDate, AcquisDate, PointId, ChnlCode, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName ) SELECT O.CustId, -1 * OP.PointSaveAmt, 'cancel' AS SaveReasonCode, O.OrderNo, OP.OrderProdNo, now() AS ValidStartDate, DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL 1 year) AS ValidEndDate, now() AS AcquisDate, 0 AS PointId, O.ChnlCode, 1 AS State, '' AS Remark, now() AS RegistDate, 'system' AS RegistId, 'system' AS RegistName FROM shopion.tOrdOrder O INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON O.OrderNo = OP.OrderNo WHERE OP.PointSaveAmt > 0 AND O.ShipCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND O.RefundCmpletDate IS NOT NULL AND O.CustId > 0 AND O.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OP.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM shopion.tPrfCustPointDetail PD WHERE O.OrderNo = PD.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = PD.OrderProdNo AND PointAmt < 0)
